job.title: Projektmanager E-Commerce (m/w/d)
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

You need a project manager who keeps business goals and shop technology aligned – I have delivered e-commerce projects at Rockwell Automation and Shell for 5+ years.

– Requirements analysis, user stories, functional specifications and UAT with business teams
– Shop know-how: catalog, promotions, order management, PIM / ERP integration
– Agile delivery with Scrum, PI Planning, Jira and Confluence

Having worked inside the delivery teams, I plan realistically and keep projects on track with developers and business alike. My CV and cover letter are attached. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Could we arrange a short call this week or next?

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Project Delivery | Techno-Functional, Requirements & Shop Integrations
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce professional with 5+ years delivering projects on large online shop platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Coordinates requirements with business stakeholders, writes user stories and functional specifications, maps processes and supports UAT, and steers delivery with development teams in agile setups (Scrum, PI Planning, Jira, Confluence). Deep know-how in catalog, promotions, order management and PIM / ERP integration, plus CI/CD release cycles. Uses generative AI tools for analysis and documentation.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Walbusch is a strong multichannel fashion retailer, and its online shop is central to reaching customers. I want to apply my experience delivering e-commerce projects on large shop platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell to move your shop forward with well-run, business-focused projects that customers notice.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am applying for Projektmanager E-Commerce at Walbusch: 5+ years techno-functional e-commerce delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, requirements to release. Based in Germany with work permit – glad to talk!

en.subject: Application: Projektmanager E-Commerce
en.hook: E-commerce projects succeed when someone keeps business goals, shop functionality and system integrations aligned. That is what I have done for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I have taken shop requirements from business stakeholders through specification and development to release on SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: Stakeholder & requirements management
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business stakeholders and product owners, wrote user stories and functional specifications, mapped processes and supported user acceptance testing (UAT) – then translated them into working SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Shop functionality
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211); developed and maintained the Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs, Impex and FlexibleSearch.

bullets.label: Integrations & dependencies
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international technical teams.

bullets.label: Releases & delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) in agile DevOps workflows; led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and supported production troubleshooting.

en.logistics: Having worked inside the delivery teams, I plan realistically and keep projects on track with developers and business alike. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can contribute from day one.
